judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.R. Swaminathan, J.:— What is under challenge in this habeas corpus petition is the detention order No. 222/BBCDEFGISSSV/2026 dated 09.04.2026 passed by the second respondent herein.

2. When the habeas corpus petition was taken up for final disposal, G.O. Rt. No. 2977, Home, Prohibition and Excise (XIII) Department, dated 19.05.2026 revoking the detention order has been produced before us.

In view of the same, nothing survives for consideration in this habeas corpus petition and the same is closed. Post W.P. CRL. No. 1121 of 2026 for hearing on 27.05.2026.
